title: Demonic Organ
description: A person sees a large pipe organ built into a broken arched stone window with a blue demon having horns and one eye appearing inside the glass. The demon's hands reach out from the glass as blue liquid drips down over the keyboard and onto an open book on the floor that shows the word STASIS.
prompt: dark fantasy painting of a large old pipe organ built into a broken arched stone window inside a ruined building. a blue demon with horns and one large eye appears trapped in the cracked glass reaching out with its hands while blue liquid drips down over the keyboard and onto the floor. an open book lies on the ground in front of it. blue flames and chains surround the scene with skulls and debris on the floor.
